title: Fifteen Years and One Long Table
subtitle: 餐饮与用餐 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 餐饮与用餐（生活与学习·饮食与用餐）
meta: 主题语境：餐饮与用餐（生活与学习·饮食与用餐）　|　核心词汇：dining　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 dining 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the housekeeper ① ran a dining that no hotel in the town would have matched, and she said the running was the whole of the house. The ② dining, meaning the eating and not the room, ran fifteen years and stayed unpraised in the visitors book; dining, she said, is the only thing in a house that is judged by how long it is left unthanked.

Every ③ dining in that house had the same long table at the middle of it, and the ④ dining at the end, meaning the one they kept for the winter guests and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever praised twice. A dining, her cook said, is nine parts order and one part somebody willing to serve; the housekeeper said the order is the part that fills fifteen years.

The steward meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the dining was the whole of the wing, meaning the room and not the eating. The ⑥ dining, meaning the room and not any of that, is the only thing in a wing that everybody measures and nobody uses; dining, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both an eating and a room. He said the room is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ dining had become a line in an inventory, and the inventory had become an argument about the long table. The ⑧ dining of the whole thing, the housekeeper wrote in December, was one house and fifteen years of serving; dining, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to serve. She said the serving was never mentioned.

The ⑨ dining I remember is the one at the end, which was last held in 1972 and is still described as the quietest in the house. A ⑩ dining, the cook said in 1974, is the only thing that improves by being praised; every dining, she said, is a room that has agreed to look like an eating. She said the room was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 用餐；进餐（指那栋房子里操办的那一顿）
B. n. 用餐（指吃饭这件事本身，与那间厅堂相对）
C. 固定搭配：run a dining 操办一应用餐
D. n. 用餐（指留给冬季来客的那一顿）
E. n. 用餐；伙食（抽象总称，指一栋房子的全部餐饮）
F. n. 用餐（指清单上写到、被列名的那一顿）
G. n. 餐厅；餐室（指侧翼里那间厅堂）
H. n. 餐室（抽象总称，指人人丈量却无人使用的那间）

items.q: ran a dining that no hotel in the town would have matched
The dining, meaning the eating and not the room
the dining was the whole of the wing
the dining had become a line in an inventory
The dining of the whole thing
A dining, the cook said in 1974

answers.why: run a dining 意为“操办一应用餐”，1949 年管家操办了一席全镇没有一家旅馆比得上的用餐。
dining 意为“用餐”，指吃饭这件事本身而不是那间厅堂，它办了十五年而在留言簿上无人称谢。
dining 意为“用餐、进餐”，指那栋房子里每一顿用餐，每一顿中间都是同一张长桌。
dining 意为“用餐”，指留给冬季来客的那一顿，是唯一有人称赞过两次的。
dining 意为“餐厅、餐室”，指侧翼里那间厅堂，总管说这间厅堂就是那个侧翼的全部。
dining 意为“餐室”，指人人丈量却无人使用的那间而不是吃饭这件事，是侧翼里人人都丈量、却无人使用的东西。
dining 意为“用餐”，指清单上写到、被列名的那一顿，到 1958 年这顿用餐成了清单里的一行。
dining 意为“用餐、伙食”，管家十二月写道，整件事的伙食是一栋房子和十五年的侍餐。
dining 意为“用餐”，我记得的是末尾那一顿，1972 年最后一次举办，至今仍被说成屋里最安静的一顿。
dining 为抽象总称，厨子 1974 年说，一应用餐是唯一会因为被称赞而变得更好的东西。
